item.title: PBS will spotlight Sun Ra and his Philly musical collective on 'American Masters'
item.description: Experimental jazz musician Sun Ra was known as the 'godfather of Afrofuturism.' He was the longtime bandleader of the Arkestra, based in Germantown. PBS will present his biography on 'American Masters' on Friday, Feb. 20.

item.title: Low Cut Connie revise ICE protest song 'Livin In the USA' for new album
item.description: Low Cut Connie released the title track off the band's new album, 'Livin in the USA,' on Monday. The song is a reworked version of a piano ballad the band dropped last year as a protest against President Trump's immigration policies.

item.title: Freezefest to bring 12-hour winter music party to The Ridley House
item.description: Freezefest is heading back to The Ridley House for another all-day winter party.

item.title: Six Flags' new regional pass covers 8 parks, including Great Adventure and Dorney
item.description: Six Flags is introducing a new Gold Pass that offers access to all of its parks within a given geographic region. The East Coast pass covers Six Flags Great Adventure in Jackson Township, New Jersey and Dorney Park, in Allentown, Pennsylvania for the first time.

item.title: African American Museum plans special events for Black History Month
item.description: The African American Museum in Philadelphia (AAMP) will host a series of events throughout February in honor of Black History Month.

item.title: The Navy Yard turns 25: A legacy of transformation and innovation
item.description: Twenty-five years ago, the future of the former Philadelphia Naval Shipyard hung in the balance. After years of uncertainty, the Shipyard had officially shut its gates on September 26, 1996—bringing the loss of tens of thousands of jobs and leaving behind a vast, silent industrial landscape.

item.title: Lou Capozzoli, musician and owner of Ray’s Happy Birthday Bar, dies at 86
item.description: Lou Capozzoli, a musician and the longtime owner of Ray’s Happy Birthday Bar, died Sunday night at the age of 86. He inherited the bar 28 years ago after the death of his father, Ray, who founded the South Philly dive in 1938.

item.title: The Schuylkill River is frozen, but walking out onto its icy surface is not just dangerous. It's illegal.
item.description: Philadelphia police are warning people to stay off the frozen Schuylkill and Delaware rivers after reports of people walking and ice skating on the ice. Moving water weakens river ice and conditions can change fast.

item.title: Instant observations: Dominick Barlow's career-best performance powers an easy Sixers win over Clippers
item.description: The best game of Dominick Barlow's young, promising NBA career lifted the Sixers past the Los Angeles Clippers, who may or may not be on the verge of trading James Harden.
